notes:
PASS on the fake backend. The driver is a model-authored, unreviewed MujocoDriver (driver.lock.json authored_by kind model, reviewed_by null) that serves the card's models[0], robogym/assets/xmls/robot/shadowhand/main.xml, in simulated mode R0. The model is read in place from the read-only pinned clone and is neither copied nor imported. The bridge derives cap.world.step.v1 (action.ctrl bounded per actuator by the model's 20 ctrlranges in joint_position_actuation.xml:72-96) and cap.world.reset.v1; the state is the bridge's integration state with 31 qpos, 30 qvel, 20 ctrl and the 8 ms step from assets.xml:14. The driver declares no Limit of its own and no operator_required bound, so no site-limits.example.json is needed. Facts cite main.xml, assets.xml, joint_position_actuation.xml, chain.xml and the two env files that load the hand model; G4 reported no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warning.

NOT COVERED: the MuJoCo engine. MuJoCo is not installed and cannot be installed where the gate runs (no network, no pip), so the fake backend is fake.py, a pure Python stand-in for the mujoco library: it expands the MJCF includes and default classes, takes the dimensions, ctrlranges and 0.008 s step from the card's model, and moves each actuated hinge toward its ctrl target with a placeholder first-order motion. It computes no inertia, torque, contact, equality, tendon or actuator dynamics, moves no joint for the four tendon-driven actuators (A_FFJ1, A_MFJ1, A_RFJ1, A_LFJ1), loads no mesh or texture and resolves no robogym asset path, and resets qpos to zero rather than MuJoCo's qpos0; the free hand_base joint is not integrated. No trajectory was compared with MuJoCo and the engine path (backend sim) was never run. No physical ShadowHand is modelled and no hardware run is claimed.

NOT COVERED: the Robogym environments. The card's entry_symbols are Gymnasium env classes (FacePerpendicularEnv, FullPerpendicularEnv, LockedEnv, ReachEnv, AttachedBlockRearrangeEnv); all five were confirmed in the clone, but the driver serves the underlying card model alone, not an environment scene. The dactyl environments compose this hand with cube, target, table and goal models (cube_env.py:151) and expose observations, rewards, goals and action spaces; none of that is served. The other card models (main_render.xml and ur16e/gripper_main.xml) are not served.

Expected simulator-family warnings: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND (the fake is the package's stand-in for the mujoco library, so there is no fake class surface to record or compare), and G8.NO_UNIT x3 for the family-derived integer inputs ticks and reset seed and the array action.ctrl[*] (the simulator uses its own units). driver.py names the fake as the class object fake.FakeMujoco; driver.lock.json records it as .fake:FakeMujoco, and G2 compares the lock only when every backend value is a string. The fidelity contract publishes engine mujoco:shadowhand, F1, exact determinism, realtime_factor 0, lockstep, full reset and snapshot_restore true; the stand-in implements the bridge's mj_getState/mj_setState calls, while the real engine was not exercised. No catalogue_requests: no x-cap extension id was used.
